verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas is well set up for AI agents: it serves llms.txt and a 2 MB llms-full.txt of complete docs, ships PlayCanvas Skills for AI coding agents in new projects, and has documented Engine and Editor APIs on a widely downloaded MIT npm package. But nothing shows LLM-generated code actually working on the first try. The scripting model has also recently shifted to ESM scripts (with ES6 module and TypeScript support arriving late), so models may have learned older patterns. missing for 10: hands-on evidence that LLM output works first try, evidence of abundant public examples in model training data, evidence of long-term API stability without pattern churn.
